free_tier.stated: No free grant on the vendor's own pricing page. deepseek-flash is USD 0.15 per 1M input tokens on a cache miss and USD 0.60 per 1M output off-peak, doubling at peak; cache hits cost USD 0.003 per 1M off-peak. The concurrency limit is 2,500 for deepseek-flash and 500 for deepseek-v4-pro, at account level, and 'There is no additional cost for capacity expansion'. Context is 1M tokens with 384K maximum output.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: the off-peak window is the chain that matters: at USD 0.15 per 1M input and 2,500 concurrency a weekend batch is the cheapest job in this class and needs no free tier at all.

limits.value: nothing binds but the balance: 2,500 concurrent requests is the highest concurrency in this class, about eight times Cloudflare's 300 requests a minute, so the only ceiling is the prepaid balance and USD 0.15 per 1M input makes a large job cheap rather than free.
